keyframe_review.note: New keyframe: Cliopatria has no shape for 1916-1946 (its Qatar row ends 1915 and the protectorate row begins 1947). The peninsula was a British protectorate from 3 November 1916. The Hawar Islands were awarded to Bahrain in 2001 and Zubarah to Qatar (History of Qatar page), so pre-2001 frontiers on those were disputed; the modern outline is used.

Cliopatria's shape is 307,788 km2 over Oman (bounding box 52.1-59.9 E, 16.7-26.4 N, the Oman country outline); the Qatar peninsula is 11,581 km2 on the Qatar infobox (ratio 27 to 1). It is the Sultanate of Oman's land, not Qatar's, and must not be drawn for the Qatar protectorate.

ledger.note: 3 November 1916: Qatar becomes a British protectorate. 'Qatar became a British protectorate on 3 November 1916'; the History of Qatar page: Abdullah bin Jassim Al Thani 'signed a treaty with Britain, thereby instating the area under the trucial system' and agreed he could cede territory only to the British. The Ottomans had left in 1915; the qatar dossier ends on the same day.

3 September 1971: the protectorate ends in independence. Infobox 'Independence from the United Kingdom: 3 September 1971' (declared 1 September); on 3 September 'the special treaty arrangements' with Britain 'were terminated'. The History of Qatar page: 'Qatar declared its independence on September 3, 1971'. Ruler Ahmad bin Ali is deposed on 22 February 1972.

certainty.note: The peninsula's coast is sharp; the land frontier with Saudi Arabia and the Hawar and Zubarah disputes with Bahrain were unsettled (the pages opened give the 2001 court ruling but no earlier line and no border treaty).

notes: Written by me-10-j from two pages. CLIOPATRIA ROW IS WRONG: both 'Qatar Protectorate' shapes (1947-1952 and 1953-1955, 307,788 km2) are the outline of Oman, not Qatar; the dossier reviews them 'wrong' and uses the State of Qatar 1973 shape instead. LIFE SPAN: the dossier runs 3 November 1916 to 3 September 1971, the protectorate's whole life, although Cliopatria dates the row 1947-1955; two new keyframes fill 1916-1946 and 1956-1971. The qatar dossier (to 1916) and the state-of-qatar row (from 1973) bracket it. No war: the pages opened give no territorial war. The British side (vassal_start 1916, vassal_end 1971, counterpart qatar-protectorate) belongs to the kingdom-of-great-britain/United Kingdom dossier. NOT READ: the Saudi-Qatar border (1965 agreement, 1992 Khafous, later treaties), the Hawar/Zubarah case; the pages are silent. Doha is not called capital for 1916-1971 by the History page, only on the Qatar infobox.
